title: An exact coNP-completeness theorem for bounded optimal-witness verification
claims: OptimalWitnessCheckingInCoNP gives a checked coNP upper bound for optimal-witness verification with arbitrary polynomial-time feasibility and comparison.
OptimalWitnessCheckingCoNPComplete exhibits a strict transitive comparator and verifier for which the language is coNP-complete under pinned polynomial reductions.
OptimalWitnessCheckingIffCollapse proves an equivalence between P = NP and polynomial-time optimality checking for every bounded verifier and comparator. Neither side is asserted unconditionally.
P_subset_NP is independently checked against the pinned definitions.

experiments.purpose: Run the pinned reference checker where available. Otherwise compare source hashes with the submitted checker transcript, without awarding experimental Lean points.
